messages:
alex_support: FYI Acme reported a billing spike + failed erasure attempts last night. They saw lots of retries when calling DELETE /v1/tenants/acme/objects — customer pasted: "error: kms handshake failed: hsm auth timeout". Need logs + DPA evidence. Looping @maria_sre @jon_security @eric_eng

maria_sre: thanks. can you share tenant id + request ids + time window? I can pull LB + runtime traces and check retry amplification.

alex_support: tenant=acme-inc-prod, example request id=rp_20260312_221703, window=2026-03-12T22:15:00Z -> 2026-03-12T22:45:00Z. Customer says they retried aggressively and token usage shot up. They also asked whether keys/HSM left EU.

eric_eng: quick note — we had a CMK rewrap started ~22:10 UTC and finished ~22:22 UTC. Might correlate. There was a short period where auth to HSM proxy returned 500/timeout for some dedicated tenants. I'm going to pull KMS audit entries.

maria_sre: repro plan to reproduce locally: 
```
# minimal repro (don't run on prod)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/erase \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-inc-prod","object_ids":["obj-123"]}'
```
If the KMS handshake times out the client retries; we need to measure idempotency tokens so retries don't double-bill.

jon_security: from the DPA angle: customer wants a proof bundle showing deletion attempts + audit log entries + KMS/HSM handshake evidence and the subprocessor list (HSM provider + cloud). We also need to confirm data residency (which region the tenant was pinned to). Marking for legal review.

lucy_csm: I'm on the thread with Acme. They want a timeline and proof by EOD tomorrow. Also asking for a goodwill credit because their invoices spiked. Suggested 10–20% credit depending on volume.

alex_support: plan: 1) collect LB access logs and runtime request traces for window 22:15-22:45, 2) export KMS audit logs for tenant CMK ops, 3) request HSM session traces from provider (cc @jon_security), 4) assemble DPA bundle (signed export + timeline), 5) propose 15% credit and offer invoice adjustment. I'll send a templated response once we have logs.

maria_sre: pulling traces now. initial grep shows ~180 requests with 503/502 in that window, ~70 unique idempotency tokens but many missing so client retried w/ new tokens. Will attach runtime snippet.

eric_eng: HSM provider (crypto-hsm-inc) returned intermittent 504s while we were rewrapping keys; I can request session-level logs — note retention is 30 days. Command I'll run: 
```
# get hsm session logs (privileged)
hsmctl --tenant acme-inc-prod sessions --since 2026-03-12T22:00Z --until 2026-03-12T23:00Z > /tmp/acme_hsm_sessions.log
```
We should also confirm whether the HSM provider is a subprocessors listed in the DPA.

jon_security: confirmed: crypto-hsm-inc is a listed subprocessor. They have EU datacenter points and sign an SCC-addendum. I'll pull the subprocessor manifest + consent timestamps for the account and add to bundle. Also need audit policy that proves we did not export tenant data outside eu-west-1 during these ops.

alex_support: can someone prepare a short customer-facing timeline showing: (a) 22:10 key rotation start, (b) 22:15-22:25 spike of 503s/504s, (c) 22:22 rotation complete, (d) retries caused extra token billing. Then propose credit. I'll draft.

maria_sre: timeline + logs coming. also noting LB retry header X-Request-Retry shows backoff pattern. Recommend we push an SDK patch to enforce idempotency-token reuse for erase endpoints so retries don't re-charge.

eric_eng: agree re: SDK. short-term mitigation: add server-side dedupe by idempotency-token for 10 minutes per tenant. I can draft the runtime change — will need quick review.

jon_security: for the DPA bundle include: exported audit.log (signed), kms-audit.csv, hsm-sessions.log, subprocessor_manifest.pdf, region_pin.csv, and a short approved statement from legal saying no data left EU. I'll coordinate with legal.

lucy_csm: I told Acme we'll follow up with timeline + credit proposal and that we are assembling their DPA evidence. They expect reply by 09:00 their time tomorrow.

alex_support: ack. tagging deploy-bot to flag the dedicated pool that served acme-inc-prod so SRE can prioritize. @deploy-bot please pin node: rdw-dedicated-eu-12

deploy-bot: pinned rdw-dedicated-eu-12 to incident channel (automated).

maria_sre: attaching quick grep output snippet (will add full artifact to ticket): `grep rp_20260312_221703 runtime.log | sed -n '1,80p'` — shows handshake timeouts ~22:16:03 -> 22:19:48.

eric_eng: requested session logs from crypto-hsm-inc — ETA 3 hours. once we have them I'll hand to @jon_security.

jon_security: legal looped in. request: include the original customer error payload in the bundle (redact PII). Also confirm if we issued any KMS re-encrypts that might have spawned additional write ops.

alex_support: thank you everyone — I'll own the customer comms and credit proposal once we have the artifacts. next steps: collect artifacts -> assemble DPA bundle -> send to legal for sign-off -> send to customer.

lucy_csm: thanks team. I'll update Acme after we confirm artifacts. :thumbsup:

alex_support: closing here for now, will update when artifacts are attached to the ticket.
